name: Chichi's Idle Bakery Tycoon
summary: Start with one oven and one shelf in a small alley bakery run by a cat named Chichi. Pick a dough, a filling and a topping at the oven bench and bake new bread: 24 breads have names, and every first bake goes into your collection. Named breads sell for more, and the bread of the day sells for extra. Where you put the ovens and shelves is your income. Baked bread fills the shelves, customers pick it up and line up at the counter, and a shelf near an oven stays fresh longer. Hire a baker, a cashier and a cafe helper, tap the glowing marks to collect, and grow the shop through six stages with 15 kinds of facilities. Customers have different tastes, and the ones who like your shop come back as regulars.
